optional_components.next_step: A managed yt-dlp is offered on Ubuntu 24.04 x86-64 only, so this plan cannot include it. Direct HTTPS video links (ingest --url) work without it, as does every local file.
optional_components.purpose: Fetches a video from a public web page (YouTube and other sites) when you give VSift a link with ingest --url, using yt-dlp and the JavaScript runtime it needs. Direct HTTPS video links work without it.
optional_components.summary: Not available here: yt-dlp (optional; GPL-3.0-or-later, with the MIT-licensed Deno runtime) fetches videos from YouTube and other sites when you give VSift a link. Downloading is subject to each site's terms.
optional_components.terms_notice: Downloading from a site is subject to that site's terms, which are yours to follow. VSift does not get round sign-in, DRM, age, region or bot checks.
